notes.title: #2 Devlog: Death system, new wiping system, rotating objects
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=V6w988IG9dE;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello galactic wipers!🧹


What's New:

🧼 New mop cleaning system – cleaning now feels smoother and more satisfying!
🔄 Item rotation – you can now freely rotate objects in the environment.
💀 Player death & respawn system – yes, you can die now... but don’t worry, you’ll come back!
👻We've improved ragdoll physics and added cloth physics for a more immersive experience.

We're currently working on a character progression system, an in-game shop where you'll be able to spend your mission-earned cash on new tools, and refining our AI!

Stay tuned and thanks for being with us – see you soon!

notes.title: #1 Devlog: New body system physics + Thank You for 20.000 wishlists!
notes.notes:
[url=https://youtu.be/NwaUcIGzvUg]CLEANER COMPANY DEVLOG #1[/url]
Hey Star Wipers! 🧹

First of all — a huge THANK YOU to everyone who has added Cleaner Company to their wishlist. We've officially hit 20,000 wishlists and we’re incredibly grateful for the amazing support from our community. Your enthusiasm truly motivates us to keep pushing the game forward. 🙏❤️

What’s New?
We’ve been hard at work improving and expanding the game. In this devlog, we’re excited to share two big updates:

🗺️ New Map Reveal
We’re introducing a brand new map for you to explore and clean! Our newest map takes you deep into a forgotten industrial district, where rusted machinery, crumbling factories, and flickering lights set the stage for your next cleanup mission.

🧍‍♂️ Body Physics System
This is a big one — we've added a body physics system! From now on, you’ll be able to clean up bodies in a more realistic and interactive way. The new system adds more depth (and dark humor) to the job of a cleaner. Handle with care!

What’s Coming Next?
We're also currently working on some major new features:

☠️ Player death system — Yes, your cleaners won't be invincible anymore.

🧠 New AI system — Smarter enemies and more dynamic encounters.

🧽 Improved mopping mechanics — New animations and interaction for wiping up messes.

We'll be showing all of these in action in the next devlog, so stay tuned!
